report_name: Frontline Education Breach Exposes School Employee SSNs

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Actor
threat_actors.description: The unauthorized actor responsible for the data breach at Frontline Education, which involved exploiting a third-party vulnerability to steal PII of school employees.
threat_actors.goals: Data theft of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) such as Social Security numbers for financial fraud or for sale on dark web marketplaces.

attack_patterns.name: Supply Chain Compromise
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor compromised the ed-tech vendor Frontline Education by exploiting a vulnerability in a third-party software application to access data from downstream school districts.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The attackers exploited an unspecified vulnerability in a third-party software component integrated into Frontline Education's environment to gain initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Data Staged
attack_patterns.description: The attackers located and aggregated sensitive employee records from a database or file stores within Frontline's environment before exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The attackers exfiltrated the stolen PII, including names, addresses, and Social Security numbers, from Frontline's systems to an external, attacker-controlled server.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor accessed and stole records from a centralized repository, likely a cloud database or storage object, containing sensitive data from numerous school districts.

vulnerabilities.name: Vulnerability in third-party software application
vulnerabilities.description: An unspecified vulnerability in a third-party software application used by Frontline Education was exploited by the threat actor to gain unauthorized access and exfiltrate data.

identities.name: Frontline Education
identities.description: A prominent provider of administrative software for K-12 school districts that was compromised in a supply chain attack, leading to the exposure of school employee data.

identities.name: School District Employees
identities.description: The group of individuals whose sensitive personal information, including names, addresses, and Social Security numbers, was exposed in the Frontline Education data breach.

identities.name: K-12 School Districts
identities.description: Downstream customers of Frontline Education whose employee data was compromised through the vendor.

infrastructure.name: Attacker-controlled Exfiltration Server
infrastructure.description: An external server controlled by the attacker to which stolen PII from Frontline Education was exfiltrated.

indicators.name: Anomalous Data Egress from Trusted Vendor IP
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Data Egress from Trusted Vendor IP
id: 2b8c1f9a-7d3e-4b1c-8a9f-0e1d2c3b4a5b
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects unusual data flows from a trusted vendor's IP range to an unknown external IP, which could indicate data exfiltration from a compromised vendor environment.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/frontline-education-data-breach-impacts-school-district-employees/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-05
tags:
  - attack.t1041
level: medium
logsource:
  category: firewall
detection:
  selection:
    SourceIp|cidr:
      - 1.2.3.0/24 # Placeholder for trusted vendor IP range
  filter_known_dest:
    DestinationIp|cidr:
      - 4.5.6.0/24 # Placeholder for known good destinations
  condition: selection and not filter_known_dest
indicators.description: Detects unusual data flows from a trusted vendor's IP range to an unknown external IP, which could indicate data exfiltration from a compromised vendor environment as seen in the Frontline Education breach.

indicators.name: Anomalous Cloud API Activity by Vendor Service Account
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Cloud API Activity by Vendor Service Account
id: 8c1d9e0f-3b4a-4c5d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: >
  Monitors for anomalous API calls or access patterns related to a vendor's service account or integration, which could indicate misuse of a compromised vendor account.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/frontline-education-data-breach-impacts-school-district-employees/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-05
tags:
  - attack.t1078.004
  - attack.t1530
level: medium
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
detection:
  selection:
    userIdentity.arn|contains: 'vendor-service-account' # Placeholder for vendor account identifier
    eventName|contains:
      - 'GetObject'
      - 'ListObjects'
      - 'GetSecretValue'
  filter_normal_activity:
    # Define normal, expected API calls for this service account here
    eventName: 'PutObject'
  condition: selection and not filter_normal_activity
indicators.description: Monitors for anomalous cloud API calls or access patterns related to a vendor's service account, indicating potential misuse for data discovery or exfiltration.
